newsitem.title: USA: TALX Corp completes sale of document unit.
newsitem.headline: TALX Corp completes sale of document unit.

text.p: TALX Corp said Monday it completed the sale of its Document Services Division to Sterling Direct Inc for an undisclosed price.
TALX said it previously announced plans to sell its document and database services operations to focus on its core interactive World Wide Web and voice communications business.
The company said Sterling Direct is the largest customer of the Document Services Division.
TALX designs and installs interactive communications and computer networks.
Its shares closed down 1/8 Monday at 8-3/8.
